Team —

Attached is the Q3 launch compact (v2) and an initial risk register. This is the consolidated plan we previewed in the leadership offsite; I need sign-off on the owners, success metrics, and the four highlighted risks so we can finalize the QBR packet on Friday. High-level asks: 

- Kimberly: confirm staffing and hiring contingency for the Serving Runtime milestone (page 3).
- Laura: confirm metrics owners for cost-per-token and latency SLAs.
- Rishi: confirm org-level escalation policy and the proposed fallback model matrix.
- Vivek: confirm channel GTM readiness and preliminary customer list for canary.

Please review the doc and the risk register attached. If you have minor edits, add inline comments in the sheet. If you're comfortable approving as-is, reply with "+1 approve" and I will lock the deck for QBR consolidation.

Attachments: Q3_slate_v2.xlsx; Risk_Register_Q3.pdf

Thanks — aiming to close approvals by EOD Thursday so CS/Comms has time to prep the QBR narrative.

Grace O'Connor
